name: ppe_carrying_amount_share_of_total_assets
question_template: A balance sheet shows property, plant and equipment at historical cost of {COST} USD with accumulated depreciation of {ACC_DEP} USD. Total assets are {TOTAL_ASSETS} USD and already include the equipment at its carrying amount. Using carrying amount = cost minus accumulated depreciation, compute the carrying amount of property, plant and equipment as a percentage of total assets, in percentage points. Use exact arithmetic.
